snippet.title: Hearts Gone Black | NEW Zombies Survival Game | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Hearts Gone Black is a upcoming single-player top-down survival horror Indie Game set in a post-apocalyptic open world.

Scavenge abandoned locations, gather resources, craft equipment, research upgrades, grow food, manage survivors, and defend your base against infected zombies or hostile survivors. Balance hunger, thirst, sanity, morale, and energy while surviving dangerous weather and difficult choices.

Wishlist Hearts Gone Black on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4934640/Hearts_Gone_Black/

Key features

• Top-down survival horror combat PVE
• Scavenging, crafting, farming, cooking, and research
• Base management and assign survivors
• More than 300 items, weapons, tools, and supplies
• Dynamic weather and temperature survival
• Barricades, traps, gadgets, explosives
• Large base defense and horde events
• A bleak world shaped by moral choices

Developed by Life is Hard Games, a solo developer.

Short version trailer 2 minutes: https://youtu.be/fYLdk0U6Odk

Planned release: Q1 2027
Wishlist the game on Steam to follow development and support the project.

Press kit & Creators Kit on 
X / Twitter: https://x.com/heartsgoneblack

#HeartsGoneBlack #SurvivalGame #IndieGame
